actionLog:
Follow-up round (2026-08-23): the follow-up text asked to make the comment menu item/page the main overall comments-and-logs center, and the admin menu item the settings page for menu items etc. This is, functionally word-for-word, the same information-architecture change already implemented and merged in PR #38 ("CommentsPanel becomes the single comment-management place, Admin panel becomes Settings"), which was written for a separate, earlier-queued work item (jynx-mt558crxb02w) asking the same thing in different words. #38 merged at 2026-08-23T06:00:13Z, a few minutes before this follow-up was filed at 06:03:37Z — the admin likely hadn't seen it land yet. Verified directly against current main: CommentsPanel.jsx (client/src/devtools/overlay/CommentsPanel.jsx) is now the single place to view/resolve/reopen/reply/edit comments across both the QA-annotation and Jynx-feedback queues, with a This-page/All-pages scope toggle and click-to-jump; DevAdminPanel.jsx is now a Settings hub with Dev Users / Menu / Logs tabs (Logs being read-only). No further code change was needed for this follow-up — re-pointing actionPrUrl from #12 (the prior round's PR, covering edit-in-place text + the Jynx-commenter tier) to #38 since #38 is what actually implements what was just asked for. History preserved above.

Earlier round: A concurrent routine run raced on this same item and produced three PRs; #12 is the one that correctly and completely covers the original request — it lets you edit a Jynx-feedback comment's own text (via the admin's Jynx tab) and adds a grantable "Jynx commenter" permission tier so an admin can let a regular dev user leave Jynx-meta feedback too, while keeping viewing/resolving/exporting the full Jynx queue admin-only exactly as asked. #9 attempted the same permission tier but accidentally also exposed the full admin feedback queue to any Jynx commenter (not just their own entries) and was closed in #12's favor. #7 (still open, separate PR) adds edit-your-own-text for regular QA-annotation comments — a related but distinct feature, not this note's own edit capability.

replies.text: Partial progress: every dev user now has their own comments view (the sidebar, with an Open/Done split and a Just me filter), can jump to a comment's location, and can reply to any comment thread. Editing your own comment text, and the separate 'jynx commenter' permission tier for regular dev users, are still open.
